model_revision_cross_check.explanation: The v6 registry pins the MinerU *code* revision, not the weights repository. There is no prior weights-repository pin to compare against. The code pin is carried separately as runtime_source_revision, where it is superseded by a later 3.4.x tag of the same repository.

base_image_digest_source: registry-1.docker.io manifest for vllm/vllm-openai:v0.21.0, anonymous pull token, 2026-09-03. This is the base MinerU's own docker/global/Dockerfile uses.

upstream_version_discrepancy.explanation: Upstream tagged 3.4.5 without bumping mineru/version.py, which still reads 3.4.4 at fbb1257a. The 3.4.5 changes are a DOCX table-cell fix and a PDF surrogate-pair fix, neither of which touches PNG page parsing. Record the git sha in every provenance receipt; a report that quotes mineru.__version__ will read 3.4.4 and that is upstream's number, not an error to correct.

runtime_dependency_pins.source: MinerU pyproject.toml at the pinned revision publishes only >= constraints; these exact versions are the ones the FOLYNTA 2026-08 bootstrap recorded in infra/runpod/v6/bootstrap/mineru-3.4.4-transformers-c1.sh.

weights_detail.repository_largest_file_not_used: models/MFR/UniMERNet/pytorch_model.bin (3,750,208,149 bytes) is the largest file in the repository but the pipeline backend does not download it.

license_notes: The pinned pyproject.toml declares license = "LicenseRef-MinerU-Open-Source-License", not a standard SPDX identifier; benchmark/v6/candidate-registry.yaml recorded it as AGPL-3.0-or-upstream-current with commercial_use unknown. status 'verified' here means the licence identity was read from the pinned source, not that commercial use is cleared. Whether it is acceptable is a founder decision. The weights repository PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0 carries its own separate terms.

historical_evidence.note: 18-page controlled subset, not a leaderboard result, and not a promotion scope.

quoted_vendor_claims.note: Quoted from the MinerU 3.4 changelog, never reproduced by this campaign.

to_verify_in_canary: model_revision_cross_check.agrees is null: the v6 registry pin is a code revision and this field pins the weights repository, so there is nothing to compare. The code pin is cross-checked separately under runtime_source_revision.

Confirm PP-OCRv6 is the OCR model the pipeline actually selects. models/OCR/paddleocr_torch contains PP-OCRv4, v5 and v6 files side by side; record the file the run loaded. Do not take 'MinerU 3.4 uses PP-OCRv6' on faith - inferring capability from a version name is exactly what the constitution forbids.

MinerU probes huggingface.co at import time when MINERU_MODEL_SOURCE is unset (models_download_utils.resolve_auto_model_source). The image sets it to local; confirm no outbound request is made during inference.

lang is 'ch', MinerU's own default, applied identically to all three benchmarks. Confirm on a Latin-script canary page before the full run; a per-benchmark override would break the fair-comparison contract (section 6.1) and is not applied.
Record importlib.metadata.version('mineru') and the git sha from /opt/arena/receipts/mineru-git-revision.txt - expect 3.4.4 and fbb1257a, per upstream_version_discrepancy above.
gpu_pool_priority entries are RunPod gpuTypeId strings taken from masterplan section 13.3; confirm each against the provider catalog snapshot.

The v0.21.0 base ships its own transformers and this image pins 4.57.3 on top. vLLM is present but unused by the pipeline backend; if a dependency conflict surfaces, the fix is a different base image, never an unpinned upgrade.

checkpoint.config_json_note: opendatalab/PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0 at ed6b654c has no top-level config.json - the repository root holds only models/, README.md and .gitattributes, and each pipeline stage carries its own config under models/. There is no single model_type to check, so the preflight checks the toolkit and the model directories instead.

framework_floor_audit.required: MinerU 3.4.5 pyproject [pipeline] extra: transformers >= 4.57.3, < 5.0.0 and torch >= 2.6.0, < 3
framework_floor_audit.image_ships: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.21.0 - its transformers version is unknown from evidence (requirements/common.txt bounds transformers >= 4.56.0, < 5 rather than pinning one), which is why bootstrap.sh installs transformers==4.57.3 exactly
framework_floor_audit.action: no pin change - bootstrap.sh and the Dockerfile already install transformers==4.57.3, accelerate==1.14.0 and mineru-vl-utils==1.0.5 exactly, which satisfies both the model's floor and the image's bound. bootstrap.sh gains an architecture preflight that asserts those pins, imports mineru.cli.common.do_parse and checks every pipeline model directory is on disk.

cuda_floor.vendor_documented_floor: none published: the vendor documents no driver floor beyond the image's own CUDA runtime
cuda_floor.capacity_note: 13.0 is the newest CUDA version RunPod filters on, so allowedCudaVersions is the single entry ["13.0"]. A capacity refusal for this model is a real refusal, not a placement that could be widened.
cuda_floor.rationale: min_cuda_version is the lowest CUDA version a RunPod host may report for this runtime to start. It is sent as the create payload's allowedCudaVersions -- every version RunPod lists at or above it -- because pod 3xag0y00rgoj4n ran this campaign's CUDA 12.9 image on a host reporting cudaVersion 12.8 and died in torch._C._cuda_init with CUDA error 804 after the pod was already billing. Read anonymously from the pinned image's own OCI config blob at the digest runtime.json pins; nothing is inferred from the image name.
